title: CSV formula-injection and spreadsheet payload defense
attackSurface: CSV exports opened by spreadsheet applications at an administrative workstation

hostile.title: Equals formula trigger
hostile.why: A leading equals sign is interpreted as a spreadsheet formula

hostile.title: Plus formula trigger
hostile.why: Spreadsheet applications can treat a leading plus as a formula

hostile.title: Minus formula trigger
hostile.why: A leading minus can begin a formula rather than a negative data value

hostile.title: At-sign formula trigger
hostile.why: Legacy spreadsheet functions can begin with an at sign

hostile.title: Whitespace-obfuscated trigger
hostile.why: Leading whitespace is often stripped before spreadsheet interpretation

hostile.title: Zero-width obfuscated trigger
hostile.why: Invisible Unicode characters can hide a trigger from casual review

hostile.title: DDE command shape
hostile.why: Dynamic data exchange formulas are a classic spreadsheet execution payload

hostile.title: Tab-prefixed formula trigger
hostile.why: A leading tab is both a formula trigger and a visual obfuscation primitive

benign.title: Quoted multiline data
benign.why: Quoted newlines are legitimate CSV content when not used as a trigger

benign.title: Unicode text data
benign.why: International text is valid spreadsheet content

benign.title: Parenthesized accounting value
benign.why: Accounting notation does not begin with a formula trigger

benign.title: Positive decimal data
benign.why: Positive decimal data is not a formula

benign.title: Hyphen inside identifier
benign.why: A hyphen inside a cell is not a leading trigger
